worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.summary: Draw an aurora across the sky over your team; physical and special damage taken under it is cut together. It can only be laid in a cold snowstorm (thunder/rain plus snow or ice underfoot), and anyone who leaves the veil loses it.
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.use.0: Block physical and special pressure at once
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.use.1: Hold a position in the snow
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.use.2: Buy a window to switch or heal
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.description: Only in a cold snowstorm (rain or thunder overhead, with snow or ice within two or three blocks underfoot) can the veil be laid on ground within %1$s blocks.
The veil has a radius of %2$s blocks and lasts %1$s, covering allies under it only.
Under it, an ally's physical damage taken is cut by %1$s and special damage by %2$s.
Raising it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the form note for the long/bright trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.form.0: Bright: physical and special cut x1.2 each, at x0.7 duration, +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.form.1: Long: base cuts, at x1.3 duration, -2 ticks wind-up and x0.95 cooldown - holds longer and raises faster, with less cover.
worldcombat.skill.auroraveil.timing: Cast on ground within %1$s blocks: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
Bright: physical and special cut x1.2 each, x0.7 duration, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown. Long: base cuts, x1.3 duration, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.95 cooldown.
The partner only considers the veil while a threat is this close and snow is falling; smaller lays it up close, larger sets it up in advance.
Push the veil at the foe
On, the veil is laid between you and the threat so the fighting line falls under it; off, it is laid at your feet.
On, the veil is only laid while another ally is within 5 blocks; off, the partner raises it as soon as it is pressured.
On, a partner holding its post will step out to lay the veil.
